verses.en: And Moses answered and said, But, behold, they will not believe me, nor hearken unto my voice: for they will say, The LORD hath not appeared unto thee.
verses.pt: Então Moisés respondeu, e disse: Eis que eles não crerão em mim, nem ouvirão minha voz; porque dirão: O SENHOR não apareceu a ti.
verses.en_web: Moses answered, “But, behold, they will not believe me, nor listen to my voice; for they will say, ‘Yahweh has not appeared to you.’”
verses.en_bbe: And Moses, answering, said, It is certain that they will not have faith in me or give ear to my voice; for they will say, You have not seen the Lord.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto him, What is that in thine hand? And he said, A rod.
verses.pt: E o SENHOR disse: Que é isso que tens em tua mão? E ele respondeu: Uma vara.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to him, “What is that in your hand?” He said, “A rod.”
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to him, What is that in your hand? And he said, A rod.

verses.en: And he said, Cast it on the ground. And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.
verses.pt: E ele lhe disse: Lança-a em terra. E ele a lançou em terra, e tornou-se uma cobra: e Moisés fugia dela.
verses.en_web: He said, “Throw it on the ground.” He threw it on the ground, and it became a snake; and Moses ran away from it.
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Put it down on the earth. And he put it down on the earth and it became a snake; and Moses went running from it.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Put forth thine hand, and take it by the tail. And he put forth his hand, and caught it, and it became a rod in his hand:
verses.pt: Então disse o SENHOR a Moisés: Estende tua mão, e toma-a pela cauda. E ele estendeu sua mão, e tomou-a, e tornou-se vara em sua mão.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand, and take it by the tail.” He stretched out his hand, and took hold of it, and it became a rod in his hand.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses, Put out your hand and take it by the tail: (and he put out his hand and took a grip of it and it became a rod in his hand:)

verses.en: That they may believe that the LORD God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath appeared unto thee.
verses.pt: Por isto crerão que se te apareceu o SENHOR, o Deus de teus pais, o Deus de Abraão, Deus de Isaque, e Deus de Jacó.
verses.en_web: “That they may believe that Yahweh, the God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has appeared to you.”
verses.en_bbe: So that they may be certain that the Lord, the God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, has been seen by you.

verses.en: And the LORD said furthermore unto him, Put now thine hand into thy bosom. And he put his hand into his bosom: and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous as snow.
verses.pt: E disse-lhe mais o SENHOR: Mete agora tua mão em teu peito. E ele meteu a mão em seu peito; e quando a tirou, eis que sua mão estava leprosa como a neve.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said furthermore to him, “Now put your hand inside your cloak.” He put his hand inside his cloak, and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous, as white as snow.
verses.en_bbe: Then the Lord said to him again, Put your hand inside your clothing. And he put his hand inside his robe: and when he took it out it was like the hand of a leper, as white as snow.

verses.en: And he said, Put thine hand into thy bosom again. And he put his hand into his bosom again; and plucked it out of his bosom, and, behold, it was turned again as his other flesh.
verses.pt: E disse: Volta a meter tua mão em teu peito; e ele voltou a meter sua mão em seu peito; e voltando-a a tirar do peito, eis que se havia voltado como a outra carne.
verses.en_web: He said, “Put your hand inside your cloak again.” He put his hand inside his cloak again, and when he took it out of his cloak, behold, it had turned again as his other flesh.
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Put your hand inside your robe again. (And he put his hand into his robe again, and when he took it out he saw that it had become like his other flesh.)

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe thee, neither hearken to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.
verses.pt: Se acontecer, que não te crerem, nem obedecerem à voz do primeiro sinal, crerão à voz do último.
verses.en_web: “It will happen, if they will not believe you or listen to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.
verses.en_bbe: And if they do not have faith in you or give ear to the voice of the first sign, they will have faith in the second sign.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe also these two signs, neither hearken unto thy voice, that thou shalt take of the water of the river, and pour it upon the dry land: and the water which thou takest out of the river shall become blood upon the dry land.
verses.pt: E se ainda não crerem nestes dois sinais, nem ouvirem tua voz, tomarás das águas do rio, e as derramará em terra; e se tornarão aquelas águas que tomarás do rio, se tornarão sangue na terra.
verses.en_web: It will happen, if they will not believe even these two signs or listen to your voice, that you shall take of the water of the river, and pour it on the dry land. The water which you take out of the river will become blood on the dry land.”
verses.en_bbe: And if they have no faith even in these two signs and will not give ear to your voice, then you are to take the water of the Nile and put it on the dry land: and the water you take out of the river will become blood on the dry land.

verses.en: And Moses said unto the LORD, O my Lord, I am not eloquent, neither heretofore, nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant: but I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.
verses.pt: Então disse Moisés ao SENHOR: Ai Senhor! Eu não sou homem de palavras de ontem nem de anteontem, nem ainda desde que tu falas a teu servo; porque sou lento no fala e incômodo de língua.
verses.en_web: Moses said to Yahweh, “O Lord, I am not eloquent, neither before now, nor since you have spoken to your servant; for I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.”
verses.en_bbe: And Moses said to the Lord, O Lord, I am not a man of words; I have never been so, and am not now, even after what you have said to your servant: for talking is hard for me, and I am slow of tongue.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto him, Who hath made man’s mouth? or who maketh the dumb, or deaf, or the seeing, or the blind? have not I the LORD?
verses.pt: E o SENHOR lhe respondeu: Quem deu a boca ao homem? Ou quem fez ao mudo e ao surdo, ao que vai e ao cego? não sou eu, o SENHOR?
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to him, “Who made man’s mouth? Or who makes one mute, or deaf, or seeing, or blind? Isn’t it I, Yahweh?
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to him, Who has made man's mouth? who takes away a man's voice or hearing, or makes him seeing or blind? Is it not I, the Lord?

verses.en: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt say.
verses.pt: Agora pois, vai, que eu serei em tua boca, e te ensinarei o que tenhas de falar.
verses.en_web: Now therefore go, and I will be with your mouth, and teach you what you shall speak.”
verses.en_bbe: So go now, and I will be with your mouth, teaching you what to say.

verses.en: And he said, O my Lord, send, I pray thee, by the hand of him whom thou wilt send.
verses.pt: E ele disse: Ai Senhor! envia por meio do que hás de enviar.
verses.en_web: He said, “Oh, Lord, please send someone else.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, O Lord, send, if you will, by the hand of anyone whom it seems good to you to send.

verses.en: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Moses, and he said, Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother? I know that he can speak well. And also, behold, he cometh forth to meet thee: and when he seeth thee, he will be glad in his heart.
verses.pt: Então o SENHOR se irou contra Moisés, e disse: Não conheço eu a teu irmão Arão, levita, e que ele fala bem? E ainda eis que ele sairá para te receber, e vendo-te, se alegrará em seu coração.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s anger burned against Moses, and he said, “What about Aaron, your brother, the Levite? I know that he can speak well. Also, behold, he comes out to meet you. When he sees you, he will be glad in his heart.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord was angry with Moses, and said, Is there not Aaron, your brother, the Levite? To my knowledge he is good at talking. And now he is coming out to you: and when he sees you he will be glad in his heart.

verses.en: And thou shalt speak unto him, and put words in his mouth: and I will be with thy mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what ye shall do.
verses.pt: Tu falarás a ele, e porás em sua boca as palavras, e eu serei em tua boca e na sua, e vos ensinarei o que deveis fazer.
verses.en_web: You shall speak to him, and put the words in his mouth. I will be with your mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what you shall do.
verses.en_bbe: Let him give ear to your voice, and you will put my words in his mouth; and I will be with your mouth and with his, teaching you what you have to do.

verses.en: And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people: and he shall be, even he shall be to thee instead of a mouth, and thou shalt be to him instead of God.
verses.pt: E ele falará por ti ao povo; e ele te será a ti em lugar de boca, e tu serás para ele em lugar de Deus.
verses.en_web: He will be your spokesman to the people; and it will happen, that he will be to you a mouth, and you will be to him as God.
verses.en_bbe: And he will do the talking for you to the people: he will be to you as a mouth and you will be to him as God.

verses.en: And thou shalt take this rod in thine hand, wherewith thou shalt do signs.
verses.pt: E tomarás esta vara em tua mão, com a qual farás os sinais.
verses.en_web: You shall take this rod in your hand, with which you shall do the signs.”
verses.en_bbe: And take in your hand this rod with which you will do the signs.

verses.en: And Moses went and returned to Jethro his father in law, and said unto him, Let me go, I pray thee, and return unto my brethren which are in Egypt, and see whether they be yet alive. And Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.
verses.pt: Assim se foi Moisés, e voltando a seu sogro Jetro, disse-lhe: Irei agora, e voltarei a meus irmãos que estão em Egito, para ver se ainda vivem. E Jetro disse a Moisés: Vai em paz.
verses.en_web: Moses went and returned to Jethro his father-in-law, and said to him, “Please let me go and return to my brothers who are in Egypt, and see whether they are still alive.” Jethro said to Moses, “Go in peace.”
verses.en_bbe: And Moses went back to Jethro, his father-in-law, and said to him, Let me go back now to my relations in Egypt and see if they are still living. And Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Moses in Midian, Go, return into Egypt: for all the men are dead which sought thy life.
verses.pt: Disse também o SENHOR a Moisés em Midiã: Vai, e volta-te ao Egito, porque mataram todos os que procuravam tua morte.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to Moses in Midian, “Go, return into Egypt; for all the men who sought your life are dead.”
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses in Midian, Go back to Egypt, for all the men are dead who were attempting to take your life.

verses.en: And Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them upon an ass, and he returned to the land of Egypt: and Moses took the rod of God in his hand.
verses.pt: Então Moisés tomou sua mulher e seus filhos, e os pôs sobre um asno, e voltou-se à terra do Egito: tomou também Moisés a vara de Deus em sua mão.
verses.en_web: Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them on a donkey, and he returned to the land of Egypt. Moses took God’s rod in his hand.
verses.en_bbe: And Moses took his wife and his sons and put them on an ass and went back to the land of Egypt: and he took the rod of God in his hand.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, When thou goest to return into Egypt, see that thou do all those wonders before Pharaoh, which I have put in thine hand: but I will harden his heart, that he shall not let the people go.
verses.pt: E disse o SENHOR a Moisés: Quando houverdes voltado ao Egito, olha que faças diante de Faraó todas as maravilhas que pus em tua mão: eu, porém, endurecerei seu coração, de modo que não deixará ir ao povo.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to Moses, “When you go back into Egypt, see that you do before Pharaoh all the wonders which I have put in your hand, but I will harden his heart and he will not let the people go.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses, When you go back to Egypt, see that you do before Pharaoh all the wonders which I have given you power to do: but I will make his heart hard and he will not let the people go.

verses.en: And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh, Thus saith the LORD, Israel is my son, even my firstborn:
verses.pt: E dirás a Faraó: O SENHOR disse assim: Israel é meu filho, meu primogênito.
verses.en_web: You shall tell Pharaoh, ‘Yahweh says, Israel is my son, my firstborn,
verses.en_bbe: And you are to say to Pharaoh, The Lord says, Israel is the first of my sons:

verses.en: And I say unto thee, Let my son go, that he may serve me: and if thou refuse to let him go, behold, I will slay thy son, even thy firstborn.
verses.pt: Já te disse que deixes ir a meu filho, para que me sirva, mas não quiseste deixá-lo ir: eis que eu vou a matar a teu filho, o teu primogênito.
verses.en_web: and I have said to you, “Let my son go, that he may serve me”; and you have refused to let him go. Behold, I will kill your son, your firstborn.’”
verses.en_bbe: And I said to you, Let my son go, so that he may give me worship; and you did not let him go: so now I will put the first of your sons to death.

verses.en: And it came to pass by the way in the inn, that the LORD met him, and sought to kill him.
verses.pt: E aconteceu no caminho, que em uma parada o SENHOR lhe saiu ao encontro, e quis matá-lo.
verses.en_web: On the way at a lodging place, Yahweh met Moses and wanted to kill him.
verses.en_bbe: Now on the journey, at the night's resting-place, the Lord came in his way and would have put him to death.

verses.en: Then Zipporah took a sharp stone, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet, and said, Surely a bloody husband art thou to me.
verses.pt: Então Zípora agarrou uma pedra afiada, e cortou o prepúcio de seu filho, e lançou-o a seus pés, dizendo: Em verdade tu me és um esposo de sangue.
verses.en_web: Then Zipporah took a flint, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet; and she said, “Surely you are a bridegroom of blood to me.”
verses.en_bbe: Then Zipporah took a sharp stone, and cutting off the skin of her son's private parts, and touching his feet with it, she said, Truly you are a husband of blood to me.

verses.en: So he let him go: then she said, A bloody husband thou art, because of the circumcision.
verses.pt: Assim lhe deixou logo ir. E ela disse: Esposo de sangue, por causa da circuncisão.
verses.en_web: So he let him alone. Then she said, “You are a bridegroom of blood,” because of the circumcision.
verses.en_bbe: So he let him go. Then she said, You are a husband of blood because of the circumcision.

verses.en: And the LORD said to Aaron, Go into the wilderness to meet Moses. And he went, and met him in the mount of God, and kissed him.
verses.pt: E o SENHOR disse a Arão: Vai receber a Moisés ao deserto. E ele foi, e encontrou-o no monte de Deus, e beijou-lhe.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to Aaron, “Go into the wilderness to meet Moses.” He went, and met him on God’s mountain, and kissed him.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Aaron, Go into the waste land and you will see Moses. So he went and came across Moses at the mountain of God, and gave him a kiss.

verses.en: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the LORD who had sent him, and all the signs which he had commanded him.
verses.pt: Então contou Moisés a Arão todas as palavras do SENHOR que lhe enviava, e todas o sinais que lhe havia dado.
verses.en_web: Moses told Aaron all Yahweh’s words with which he had sent him, and all the signs with which he had instructed him.
verses.en_bbe: And Moses gave Aaron an account of all the words of the Lord which he had sent him to say, and of all the signs which he had given him orders to do.

verses.en: And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel:
verses.pt: E foram Moisés e Arão, e juntaram todos os anciãos dos filhos de Israel:
verses.en_web: Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: Then Moses and Aaron went and got together all the chiefs of the children of Israel:

verses.en: And Aaron spake all the words which the LORD had spoken unto Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.
verses.pt: E falou Arão todas as palavras que o SENHOR havia dito a Moisés, e fez o sinais diante dos olhos do povo.
verses.en_web: Aaron spoke all the words which Yahweh had spoken to Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.
verses.en_bbe: And Aaron said to them all the words the Lord had said to Moses, and did the signs before all the people.

verses.en: And the people believed: and when they heard that the LORD had visited the children of Israel, and that he had looked upon their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshipped.
verses.pt: E o povo creu; e ouvindo que o SENHOR havia visitado os filhos de Israel, e que havia visto sua aflição, inclinaram-se e adoraram.
verses.en_web: The people believed, and when they heard that Yahweh had visited the children of Israel, and that he had seen their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshiped.
verses.en_bbe: And the people had faith in them; and hearing that the Lord had taken up the cause of the children of Israel and had seen their troubles, with bent heads they gave him worship.
